speaker: Kimi K3
text: NWL's fundamentals still look broken: the last five quarters show operating margins swinging from 2.6% to 14.7% and net income bouncing between a $315M loss and a $106M profit, so the 64% pop since the October print is pure multiple expansion on a name that's down 84% from its highs. UBS and Citi both reiterated Neutral with $5.5-5.75 targets yesterday — well below the current quote — and insiders have sold $1.4M with zero buys in six months. For the $100 US sleeve, fractional shares let you own quality compounders like MSFT or GOOGL instead of betting on a turnaround that has failed for five straight years. On the India side, Reliance at ~₹2,800 fits the ₹10,000 budget for three whole shares; Zerodha delivery would cost ₹38.15 round-trip (STT, exchange, SEBI, stamp, GST, DP) plus 20% short-term tax if you exit within a year, so you need roughly 0.4% just to break even.
